sloka: सा मया राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः ।राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिर्दृष्टा हि प्रमदावने ।। ५.५९.३० ।।।।
transliteration: sā mayā rākṣasīmadhye tarjyamānā muhurmuhuḥ ।rākṣasībhirvirūpābhirdṛṣṭā hi pramadāvane ।। 5.59.30 ।।।।

translations.english: "I saw Sita often threatened by uglylooking ogresses. Wearing a single braid, she looked pathetic, thinking always about her husband, lying on the bare ground. She was like a lustreless lotus in winter. Spurning the advances by Ravana, she is rather determined to commit suicide.
